name: macd_trend_continuation_5s
author: adapted from QuantGen_Subagent_2
thesis: Momentum breeds momentum in intraday equities. When the MACD line crosses the signal line in the direction of the primary trend, it flags an acceleration of institutional buying/selling. Exists due to autocorrelated order flow.
mechanism: MACD divergence between price and momentum indicates that the dominant order flow is weakening. While price continues in one direction by inertia, the declining momentum shows fewer aggressive orders in that direction. Reversal occurs when the weakened flow is overwhelmed by opposing liquidity and new directional participants enter.

conditions: close > ema_50 AND CROSSOVER(macd_line, macd_signal) AND macd_line < 0
close < ema_50 AND CROSSUNDER(macd_line, macd_signal) AND macd_line > 0

weaknesses: Late entry compared to pure price action breakouts
Susceptible to sudden mean-reverting algorithmic spikes
adaptation_notes: Converted from 15min to 5s bars. Lookback multiplier: 180x. Adaptations: timeframe scaling to 5-second candles; signal conversion from individual stock to NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index; lookback period scaling for 5-second bars; stop/target recalibration for 5-second timeframe. Stop/target calibrated for options point-based exits. Universe narrowed to NIFTY index.
